title: Before the Arrest: Benchmarking LLMs on Criminal Profiling from Incomplete Evidence

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the gender misjudgment rate by measuring the proportion of misidentified suspects predicted as male when evidence is incomplete or unknown.
